ignoreValues.reason: Explicit user request to port ui/cyberpunk/CyberpunkUIKit's visual language; the kit's own source (--cp-glow: 0 0 5px accent, GlowText text-shadow, section-header underline glow) is authored with these exact glow shadows as its genre look, same sanctioned-exception class as FalloutTerminal/CrtNotFound's CRT scanline look per the template library's own meta.md ("kept intentionally... not stripped as branding").
